text:
Maya: FYI cost dashboard flagged a big negative delta on prefetch credits for tenant `northstar` at 04:12
Rajat: negative delta how big?
Maya: about -$2.4k on the hourly card, sparkline spikes down then back up
Lena: could be duplicate attribution from router + batcher. we saw similar on canary last month
ops-bot: deploy(econ-collector): canary started for econ-collector@2025-02-14
Diego: quick mitigation: UI clamp to 0 and show "estimated" badge. low risk
Priya: agree. also add a small "confidence" meter driven by dedupe_confidence so customers know it's noisy
Rajat: I'll add fields `emitter_id` and `orig_event_id` to prefetch events in the next emitter rollout to allow deterministic dedupe
Lena: we'll need an ingestion migration to preserve old events. let's make this a staged schema change
Maya: can someone add an alert rule: if prefetch_savings < 0 OR prefetch_fraction > 0.6 then tag and notify tenant owner
Diego: done, added rule to econ-alerts; will include a debug link showing raw events
Priya: UX follow-up: add toggle "Hide estimation" on tenant dashboard for slides/demos
Maya: thanks all. I'll open a console PR to clamp and wire the confidence pill
